reason: Seven implemented GTM tools with complete literal schemas; write bodies and CSV handling have implementation limitations requiring review.
server: app.py Flask JSON-RPC POST / (also /mcp/tools and discovery descriptor)
exposure: All seven tools always listed. ALLOW_GTM_WRITES defaults to 0 and gates all creation/batch-apply invocations, including dryRun; optional MCP_SHARED_KEY gates POST requests.
limitations: Static AST extraction of the exact tools_descriptor literal; no GTM calls or runtime credential use. No defaults exist in advertised schemas; handler defaults are implementation-only.
batch_plan_from_csv/create_trigger row mapping omits eventName and useRegex, so CSV CUSTOM_EVENT triggers cannot be applied successfully (lines 616-632).
create_trigger advertises up to five filters, but direct calls have no schema maxItems or handler cap; ANY uses an unverified or condition with nested conditions in parameter (lines 120-139).
batch_apply_from_csv collects nested JSON-RPC error results in applied without inspecting isError and always reports ok=true (lines 662-694).
audit_container error path receives a tuple from mcp_invoke, leaves data=None and then calls data.get, obscuring the original audit error (lines 401-410, 732-735, 787-789).
Creation bodies have not been validated against live GTM; custom-event conditions, GA4 configuration tag references and trigger-specific parameter layouts need API compatibility review.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List workspace IDs and names for a container.
tools.behavior: Lists GTM workspace IDs, names and descriptions through the Tag Manager v2 API.

tools.name: audit_container
tools.description: Audit a GTM container and summarize GA4 tags/triggers with lint rules.
tools.behavior: Lists workspace tags, triggers and variables and reports GA4 configuration/event lint findings.

tools.name: create_ga4_config_tag
tools.description: Create a GA4 Configuration tag in a GTM workspace.
tools.behavior: Creates a gaawc tag with measurementId and sendPageView parameters, or returns its planned body when dryRun is true.
tools.exposure: Always listed; invocation requires ALLOW_GTM_WRITES truthy, including dryRun. Default ALLOW_GTM_WRITES=0 disables invocation.

tools.name: create_ga4_event_tag
tools.description: Create a GA4 Event tag. Provide either measurementId OR a GA4 Config tag reference (configTagId or configTagName).
tools.behavior: Resolves trigger names and optional configuration tag names, then creates a gaawe event tag or returns its planned body.
tools.exposure: Always listed; invocation requires ALLOW_GTM_WRITES truthy, including dryRun. Default ALLOW_GTM_WRITES=0 disables invocation.

tools.name: create_trigger
tools.description: Create a GTM Trigger (Pageview, DOM Ready, Window Loaded, Custom Event, Click, Link Click, Form Submission, History Change, Timer, JS Error, Element Visibility, YouTube Video, Trigger Group). Supports filter_logic + up to 5 filters.
tools.behavior: Maps supported trigger type names to GTM types, builds trigger parameters and filters, and creates a trigger or returns its planned body.
tools.exposure: Always listed; invocation requires ALLOW_GTM_WRITES truthy, including dryRun. Default ALLOW_GTM_WRITES=0 disables invocation.

tools.name: batch_plan_from_csv
tools.description: Parse CSV text following the template and return a dry-run plan (no writes).
tools.behavior: Parses CSV rows into ordered-action candidate arguments and counts without calling the GTM API.

tools.name: batch_apply_from_csv
tools.description: Parse CSV text and apply in dependency order (Triggers -> GA4 Config -> GA4 Event). Respects dryRun in rows and ALLOW_GTM_WRITES.
tools.behavior: Parses CSV rows and recursively calls trigger, GA4 configuration and GA4 event creation in dependency order.
tools.exposure: Always listed; invocation requires ALLOW_GTM_WRITES truthy, including dryRun. Default ALLOW_GTM_WRITES=0 disables invocation.
